Preventative Dental Services With Our Dentist in Pineville

[/et_pb_text][et_pb_text _builder_version=”4.20.0″ _module_preset=”default” text_font=”Poppins||||||||” text_text_color=”#000000″ text_font_size=”16px” text_line_height=”1.8em” link_font=”||||on|||#000000|” link_text_color=”#000000″ text_font_size_tablet=”” text_font_size_phone=”14px” text_font_size_last_edited=”on|phone” locked=”off” global_colors_info=”{}”]

Your oral hygiene helps boost your confidence. But did you know it’s also essential for maintaining your overall health? At Locke Family Dentistry, our priority is using preventative dentistry to protect your teeth and gums from painful diseases that result in costly dental procedures. Our preventative dentist in Pineville, LA, Dr. Virignia Locke, has the skills and tools to protect your oral health from complications like gum disease and cavities. 

We’re proud to provide reliable preventative dentistry services in Central Louisiana for your whole family, so you’ll feel confident that your teeth are clean and healthy. Discover our preventative and general dental services with our guide below.

[/et_pb_text][/et_pb_column][et_pb_column type=”1_2″ _builder_version=”4.16″ _module_preset=”default” global_colors_info=”{}”][et_pb_text _builder_version=”4.20.0″ _module_preset=”default” header_2_font=”Poiret One|600|||||||” header_2_text_align=”left” header_2_text_color=”#FFFFFF” header_2_font_size=”35px” header_2_line_height=”1.2em” text_orientation=”center” custom_margin=”||10px||false|false” header_2_font_size_tablet=”42px” header_2_font_size_phone=”30px” header_2_font_size_last_edited=”on|phone” header_text_shadow_style=”preset5″ header_2_text_shadow_style=”preset5″ header_2_text_shadow_horizontal_length=”0.03em” header_2_text_shadow_vertical_length=”0.03em” header_2_text_shadow_color=”#000000″ locked=”off” global_colors_info=”{}”]

What Is Preventative Dentistry?

[/et_pb_text][et_pb_text _builder_version=”4.20.2″ _module_preset=”default” text_font=”Poppins||||||||” text_text_color=”#000000″ text_font_size=”16px” text_line_height=”1.8em” link_font=”||||on|||#000000|” link_text_color=”#000000″ text_font_size_tablet=”” text_font_size_phone=”14px” text_font_size_last_edited=”on|phone” locked=”off” global_colors_info=”{}”]

Preventative dentistry is the practice of protecting your teeth from harmful dental conditions, such as tooth decay and gum disease. We’ll professionally deep clean your teeth and check for any underlying dental health problems during your routine appointment. Our Pineville, LA preventative dentist recommends scheduling your preventative appointments at our Pineville dental office every six months.

[/et_pb_text][/et_pb_column][/et_pb_row][et_pb_row use_custom_gutter=”on” _builder_version=”4.20.0″ _module_preset=”default” max_width=”100%” custom_margin=”||25px||false|false” custom_padding=”0px||0px||true|false” locked=”off” global_colors_info=”{}”][et_pb_column type=”4_4″ _builder_version=”4.16″ _module_preset=”default” global_colors_info=”{}”][et_pb_text _builder_version=”4.20.0″ _module_preset=”default” header_2_font=”Poiret One|600|||||||” header_2_text_align=”left” header_2_text_color=”#FFFFFF” header_2_font_size=”60px” header_2_line_height=”1.2em” text_orientation=”center” custom_margin=”||10px||false|false” header_2_font_size_tablet=”42px” header_2_font_size_phone=”40px” header_2_font_size_last_edited=”on|phone” header_text_shadow_style=”preset5″ header_2_text_shadow_style=”preset5″ header_2_text_shadow_horizontal_length=”0.03em” header_2_text_shadow_vertical_length=”0.03em” header_2_text_shadow_color=”#000000″ locked=”off” global_colors_info=”{}”]

Preventative Dental Services:

[/et_pb_text][/et_pb_column][/et_pb_row][et_pb_row column_structure=”1_3,1_3,1_3″ use_custom_gutter=”on” _builder_version=”4.20.0″ _module_preset=”default” max_width=”100%” custom_margin=”||0px||false|false” custom_padding=”0px||0px||true|false” locked=”off” global_colors_info=”{}”][et_pb_column type=”1_3″ _builder_version=”4.16″ _module_preset=”default” global_colors_info=”{}”][et_pb_text _builder_version=”4.20.0″ _module_preset=”default” header_2_font=”Poiret One|600|||||||” header_2_text_align=”left” header_2_text_color=”#FFFFFF” header_2_font_size=”35px” header_2_line_height=”1.2em” text_orientation=”center” custom_margin=”||10px||false|false” header_2_font_size_tablet=”42px” header_2_font_size_phone=”30px” header_2_font_size_last_edited=”on|phone” header_text_shadow_style=”preset5″ header_2_text_shadow_style=”preset5″ header_2_text_shadow_horizontal_length=”0.03em” header_2_text_shadow_vertical_length=”0.03em” header_2_text_shadow_color=”#000000″ locked=”off” global_colors_info=”{}”]

Professional Teeth Cleanings

[/et_pb_text][et_pb_text _builder_version=”4.20.2″ _module_preset=”default” text_font=”Poppins||||||||” text_text_color=”#000000″ text_font_size=”16px” text_line_height=”1.8em” link_font=”||||on|||#000000|” link_text_color=”#000000″ hover_enabled=”0″ text_font_size_tablet=”” text_font_size_phone=”14px” text_font_size_last_edited=”on|phone” locked=”off” global_colors_info=”{}” sticky_enabled=”0″]

Keeping your teeth clean and free of plaque is an essential part of dental health care. Plaque is a thin film of bacteria that can build up in hard-to-reach places in your mouth. When plaque is left to collect on your teeth, it can harden into a sticky, white substance called tartar. Tartar creates pockets between your teeth and gums that cause periodontal (gum) disease and tooth loss. 

Along with daily brushing and flossing at home, the most effective way to rid your mouth of bacteria, plaque, and tartar is by regularly visiting our Pineville general dentist for professional deep cleanings. We use gentle methods and specialized tools to remove harmful bacteria from your mouth, keeping your smile vibrant and shiny.

[/et_pb_text][/et_pb_column][et_pb_column type=”1_3″ _builder_version=”4.16″ _module_preset=”default” global_colors_info=”{}”][et_pb_text _builder_version=”4.20.0″ _module_preset=”default” header_2_font=”Poiret One|600|||||||” header_2_text_align=”left” header_2_text_color=”#FFFFFF” header_2_font_size=”35px” header_2_line_height=”1.2em” text_orientation=”center” custom_margin=”||10px||false|false” header_2_font_size_tablet=”42px” header_2_font_size_phone=”30px” header_2_font_size_last_edited=”on|phone” header_text_shadow_style=”preset5″ header_2_text_shadow_style=”preset5″ header_2_text_shadow_horizontal_length=”0.03em” header_2_text_shadow_vertical_length=”0.03em” header_2_text_shadow_color=”#000000″ locked=”off” global_colors_info=”{}”]

Tooth-Colored Fillings

[/et_pb_text][et_pb_text _builder_version=”4.20.2″ _module_preset=”default” text_font=”Poppins||||||||” text_text_color=”#000000″ text_font_size=”16px” text_line_height=”1.8em” link_font=”||||on|||#000000|” link_text_color=”#000000″ hover_enabled=”0″ text_font_size_tablet=”” text_font_size_phone=”14px” text_font_size_last_edited=”on|phone” locked=”off” global_colors_info=”{}” sticky_enabled=”0″]

Dr. Locke is a skilled restorative dentist in Pineville, as well, and can repair shallow cavities in your teeth using high-quality tooth-colored fillings. Unlike the metal fillings that used to be common practice in dentistry, we customize composite fillings to match the natural color of your teeth. Tooth-colored fillings can also discreetly protect your teeth from further damage caused by tooth decay.

[/et_pb_text][et_pb_text _builder_version=”4.20.0″ _module_preset=”default” header_2_font=”Poiret One|600|||||||” header_2_text_align=”left” header_2_text_color=”#FFFFFF” header_2_font_size=”35px” header_2_line_height=”1.2em” text_orientation=”center” custom_margin=”||10px||false|false” header_2_font_size_tablet=”42px” header_2_font_size_phone=”30px” header_2_font_size_last_edited=”on|phone” header_text_shadow_style=”preset5″ header_2_text_shadow_style=”preset5″ header_2_text_shadow_horizontal_length=”0.03em” header_2_text_shadow_vertical_length=”0.03em” header_2_text_shadow_color=”#000000″ locked=”off” global_colors_info=”{}”]

Fluoride Treatments

[/et_pb_text][et_pb_text _builder_version=”4.20.2″ _module_preset=”default” text_font=”Poppins||||||||” text_text_color=”#000000″ text_font_size=”16px” text_line_height=”1.8em” link_font=”||||on|||#000000|” link_text_color=”#000000″ hover_enabled=”0″ text_font_size_tablet=”” text_font_size_phone=”14px” text_font_size_last_edited=”on|phone” locked=”off” global_colors_info=”{}” sticky_enabled=”0″]

Along with your sealants, we can strengthen and preserve your tooth enamel using fluoride treatments. These safe and gentle topical treatments are useful to maintain the hardness of your teeth and protect them from future decay. We utilize these treatments for patients of all ages, though children and teenagers with new adult teeth will especially benefit from fluoride treatment.

[/et_pb_text][/et_pb_column][et_pb_column type=”1_3″ _builder_version=”4.16″ _module_preset=”default” global_colors_info=”{}”][et_pb_text _builder_version=”4.20.0″ _module_preset=”default” header_2_font=”Poiret One|600|||||||” header_2_text_align=”left” header_2_text_color=”#FFFFFF” header_2_font_size=”35px” header_2_line_height=”1.2em” text_orientation=”center” custom_margin=”||10px||false|false” header_2_font_size_tablet=”42px” header_2_font_size_phone=”30px” header_2_font_size_last_edited=”on|phone” header_text_shadow_style=”preset5″ header_2_text_shadow_style=”preset5″ header_2_text_shadow_horizontal_length=”0.03em” header_2_text_shadow_vertical_length=”0.03em” header_2_text_shadow_color=”#000000″ locked=”off” global_colors_info=”{}”]

Dental Sealants

[/et_pb_text][et_pb_text _builder_version=”4.20.2″ _module_preset=”default” text_font=”Poppins||||||||” text_text_color=”#000000″ text_font_size=”16px” text_line_height=”1.8em” link_font=”||||on|||#000000|” link_text_color=”#000000″ hover_enabled=”0″ text_font_size_tablet=”” text_font_size_phone=”14px” text_font_size_last_edited=”on|phone” locked=”off” global_colors_info=”{}” sticky_enabled=”0″]

Dental sealants are a convenient and affordable preventative treatment used to create smooth surfaces on your teeth and fill the holes that can potentially become cavities. Our tooth-colored sealants help keep food particles and bacteria out of the hard-to-brush parts of your teeth, especially your molars.

While we highly recommend dental sealants for children and teenagers, we provide this service for patients of any age who want to protect and seal their teeth from harmful bacteria. Ask our dentist, Dr. Locke, about dental sealants during your next preventative dental visit.
